zone.description: The default zone, for every network not named home. Incoming connections are rejected, except those a desktop needs: IPv6 address setup, finding printers and devices (mDNS) and browsing Windows shares. Pairing a phone with GSConnect is only for the networks named home (amethystora-home, ame security home-networks). Open more with Firewall (firewall-config) or firewall-cmd.
